natspec.notice: One-shot initializer for the ERC-1155 Supply extension — registers IERC1155Supply via ERC-165 (the counters start at zero). Delegatecalled by {Diamond.initialize} (through {MultiInit}) inside the initializing window opened by the diamond, alongside the base {ERC1155Init}; it must NOT open its own pre/postInitializer. Run it only on a diamond that holds no balances yet (see {ERC1155SupplyLib}).
